CustomField.description: The whole definition of one program, as JSON. One field rather than a column per attribute, so a new attribute is an edit here instead of a field deploy. GARP_Portal_ProgramCatalog parses it strictly into a typed class: an unknown or misspelled key throws rather than reading as null, and the record is reported on the response warnings instead of failing the page. Schema: code, aliases[], sortOrder, active, contractRecordType, examProgramValue, examTypeKey, partKeys[], sittingModel, examGroupSwitch, suppressedByContract, countsTowardCpd, hasExamResults, hasRegistrationWindow, and a catalogue object of abbrevName, formalName, informalName, policyURL, regLogoURL, myProgramsLogoURL, description, registrationPath. A catalogue key that is absent serialises as null; one set to "" serialises as an empty string, and the two are not interchangeable.
CustomField.label: Config
